Settings.title: Setting
Settings.readOnlyNote: Only an Admin can change these values.
Settings.adminNote: Material types and outlets can be added, renamed, reordered and deleted. Style and temp keep their values; only their names and order change.

beverageStyle.label: Beverage Style
beverageStyle.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.
beverageStyle.adminRule: You can add styles, rename them in each language and change the order. Styles cannot be deleted.

unit.label: Unit
unit.rule: g and ml only; not free text.

temp.label: Temp
temp.adminRule: The options are fixed. You can rename them in each language and change the order.

materialType.label: Material Type
materialType.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.
materialType.adminRule: Add, rename, reorder or delete. A type already used by a material is disabled instead of deleted.

beanOrigins.label: Coffee Origins
beanOrigins.rule: Origins offered for Coffee Bean raw materials. Anything else can be typed in the form.
beanOrigins.adminRule: Countries offered when entering a Coffee Bean raw material; staff can still type their own. Add, rename, reorder or disable here (disabled names stay on existing beans).

beanVarieties.label: Coffee Varieties
beanVarieties.rule: Varieties offered for Coffee Bean raw materials. Anything else can be typed in the form.
beanVarieties.adminRule: Varieties offered when entering a Coffee Bean raw material; staff can still type their own. Add, rename, reorder or disable here (disabled names stay on existing beans).

beanProcesses.label: Coffee Processes
beanProcesses.rule: Processes offered for Coffee Bean raw materials. Anything else can be typed in the form.
beanProcesses.adminRule: Processes offered when entering a Coffee Bean raw material; staff can still type their own. Add, rename, reorder or disable here (disabled names stay on existing beans).

outlet.label: Outlet
outlet.adminRule: Add, rename, reorder or delete. An outlet already in use is disabled instead of deleted.

currency.label: Currency
currency.rule: Only MYR at launch. More currencies may be added later; there is no currency conversion.

language.label: Language
language.rule: English, Simplified Chinese and Malay enabled.
language.adminRule: Fixed: English, Simplified Chinese and Malay.

grinders.label: Grinders
grinders.adminRule: Add grinders here; each outlet picks its own in Outlet Equipment. A grinder cannot be deleted, only disabled, so past records keep it.

machines.label: Espresso machines
machines.rule: Espresso machines the outlets can use.
machines.adminRule: Add espresso machines here; each outlet picks its own in Outlet Equipment. A machine cannot be deleted, only disabled, so past records keep it.

brewers.label: Hand Brew Kits
brewers.rule: Hand brew kits the outlets can use for filter coffee.
brewers.adminRule: Add pour-over or batch hand brew kits here; each outlet picks its own in Outlet Equipment. A kit cannot be deleted, only disabled, so past records keep it.

outletEquipment.label: Outlet Equipment
outletEquipment.rule: The espresso machines, grinders and hand brew kits each outlet uses.
outletEquipment.adminRule: Tick the espresso machines, grinders and hand brew kits your outlet uses. Daily calibration offers only these.

WORKS_AS_DESIGNED.label: Works as designed
WORKS_AS_DESIGNED.text: We checked: this is how the feature is meant to work, not a system error. Ask your manager if you are not sure how to use it.

CANNOT_REPRODUCE.label: Can't reproduce
CANNOT_REPRODUCE.text: We tried the same steps but could not make it happen. If it happens again, please send a new report with a screenshot.

ALREADY_FIXED.label: Already fixed
ALREADY_FIXED.text: This has already been fixed. Please refresh the page, or log out and log in again.

NEED_DETAILS.label: Need more details
NEED_DETAILS.text: We need more details to act on this. Please send a new report with the steps you took and a screenshot.

PERMISSION.label: Role permission
PERMISSION.text: This is limited by your role on purpose. Ask your manager or Admin if you need access.

DEVICE_NETWORK.label: Device or network
DEVICE_NETWORK.text: This looks like a device or internet connection problem, not the app. Please check your connection and update your browser.

DUPLICATE.label: Duplicate
DUPLICATE.text: This was already reported. We are following it up in another report.

ALREADY_EXISTS.label: Already exists
ALREADY_EXISTS.text: The app can already do this. Ask your manager to show you where it is.

NOT_FIT_WORKFLOW.label: Doesn't fit our workflow
NOT_FIT_WORKFLOW.text: Thanks for the idea. It does not fit how our outlets work or our SOPs, so we won't add it.

NOT_PRIORITY.label: Not a priority now
NOT_PRIORITY.text: Good idea, but other work comes first right now. We may look at it again later.

COST_TOO_HIGH.label: Too much work for the benefit
COST_TOO_HIGH.text: This would take a lot of work for a small benefit, so we won't do it for now.

AFFECTS_OTHERS.label: Affects other users
AFFECTS_OTHERS.text: This change would make things harder for other outlets or roles, so we won't add it.

POLICY.label: Against company rules
POLICY.text: This goes against company rules (approvals, cost control or data access), so we can't add it.
